research_slices.title: Reconcile signed-artifact legacy preimage and additive canonical profile
research_slices.goal: Produce a byte-accurate, reviewable compatibility finding and known-answer evidence for the legacy signature profile and any distinct new profile.
research_slices.enables: A follow-on implementation can preserve all existing serde JSON signature bytes while adding deterministic-CBOR records without implicit re-signing or rehashing.

oracle.expected: The report identifies exact legacy serde_json::to_vec(SignedBody) bytes and includes vectors that independently verify unchanged; a new profile excludes its signature and envelope ID from its own signed preimage.
oracle.verifier: A standalone validator checks report fields and invokes/compares independent known-answer vector metadata; the follow-on Rust compatibility test is a separate file owned by 9110-11.

research_slices.rollback: Discard the research report/vector/validator draft; no source artifact bytes, signature preimages, or versioned-design file are modified.
research_slices.design_section: Cross-part identity profiles consumed by the ports

research_slices.title: Trace Atlas content_hash production and define its exact producer contract
research_slices.goal: Locate and pin the actual Atlas content_hash producer or establish that none is available, then state exact bytes/profile and an independent oracle.
research_slices.enables: Atlas ID/profile interoperability remains blocked until the source producer, canonical bytes, algorithm/profile, and known-answer vector agree.

oracle.expected: Either a pinned producer and exact input-byte/profile known-answer vector are verified, or the report explicitly records producer unavailable and forbids interop claims.
oracle.verifier: A dedicated validator checks provenance, exact byte/profile fields, independent recomputation vector, and the conservative no-producer disposition.

research_slices.rollback: Remove draft report/vector/validator only; retain the conservative rule that consumers and fixtures do not establish producer semantics.
research_slices.design_section: Remaining evidence gaps and conservative defaults
research_slices.trigger: Before any Atlas content_hash interoperability claim or when the external production pipeline is located.
